note: Switched from full SAGE-CNN to SAGE-CNN w/o SAF for deployment robustness. Although SAF shows comparable performance on in-distribution data, ablation experiments and cross-speed deployment results indicate that removing SAF improves generalization stability (deployment_robust test macro_f1: 0.9344 vs 0.9283). Label order follows the trained model logits: normal, wheel_slip, drive_abnormal, shaft_eccentricity.
